name: Erik Karlsson
bio:
Erik Karlsson's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing in the snowy landscapes of Sweden. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and aerodynamics. After graduation, Erik quickly climbed the ranks, starting as a data analyst for a smaller racing team before transitioning to a performance engineer role. His knack for optimizing car setups and his clear communication style earned him respect and promotions.

He joined Scuderia Ferrari five years ago as a senior strategist, impressing the team with his ability to anticipate race scenarios and make crucial calls under pressure. Erik's promotion to Sporting Director reflects his exceptional organizational skills and his knack for motivating his team. He's known for his calm demeanor even in high-stress environments, fostering a positive and collaborative atmosphere within the garage. His analytical approach, combined with his understanding of team dynamics, makes him a valuable asset to Ferrari.

What sets Erik apart is his 'big picture' thinking. He doesn't just focus on the immediate race; he understands how each decision impacts the overall championship strategy. He's also a strong advocate for innovation, pushing the team to explore new technologies and approaches to gain a competitive edge. Erik's goal is to lead Ferrari to multiple championship victories, solidifying his legacy as one of the sport's most insightful sporting directors.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the side
physical.description: Erik is a man of medium height with a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with racing stats and strategies.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong black coffee before every race.
